text:
jamal: heads up — noticed a perf regression on TP after last runtime change. p99 step latency up ~12% for 8-GPU runs when per-GPU all-reduce messages are small (<64KB).

maria: hmm. is this only with the tree algorithm enabled?

jamal: looks like it. we defaulted to NCCL tree for <128KB to reduce latency, but profiler shows more stalls. ring was faster for our workload. attached short trace.

alex: can you paste the perf counters / timeline? small messages should favor tree in theory due to fewer hops, but rings overlap comm/compute better.

jamal: pasted snippet from nvprof timeline:
```
step 123: forward kernels finish, then repeated 8x small allreduce ops ~40KB each
comm op durations: 0.9ms, 1.1ms, 0.95ms ...
CPU wait spikes between ops ~0.6ms
overall allreduce phase serialized, no overlap with gemm on some ranks
```

infra-bot: deploy-notice: runtime v2.14 rolled 1736080000 -> changed kernel-selection: prefer tree for small messages.

sasha: could be batching heuristic + KV cache pattern. when KV cache hits are low, sequence lengths shorter -> more frequent small reduces. did we change batching thresholds?

jamal: yes — we lowered max batch window to reduce latency earlier this month. that made more micro-batches and smaller per-GPU grad chunks. I think combo = tree choice + smaller msg sizes + less comm/compute overlap.

maria: quick experiment suggestion: force NCCL_RING for TP and run the 8-GPU perf harness with current batching. if p99 returns to baseline then we know selection heuristic is wrong.

alex: agree. also add a run with coalescing enabled (combine adjacent allreduces into ~256KB chunks) to see impact. If coalescing brings latency down, we should change heuristic to consider aggregate outstanding bytes, not single-op size.

jamal: will run both. initial numbers: baseline (pre-change) p99=210ms, after change p99=235ms, with forced ring p99=218ms, with coalesce p99=212ms. short run but indicates ring/coalesce help.

sasha: thanks. can you also dump ncclTopo and PCIe bandwidth? if tree mapping ends up crossing PCIe root complexes badly it can kill overlap.

jamal: good call — topology shows two ranks across different sockets causing extra hops in tree mode. attaching summary in next message after runs finish.

alex: follow-ups: (1) revert tree-as-default until we fix heuristic; (2) update kernel-selection to consider outstanding aggregate bytes + KV-cache hit ratio; (3) add microbenchmark in CI for small-message TP runs.

maria: +1 to adding microbench. also add a regression alert for p99 > +5% on TP perf suite.

jamal: ok i'll queue a revert PR and upload traces to the perf bucket. thanks all :thumbsup:
